newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates-Quoted at steady to higher levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates-Quoted at steady to higher levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to higher levels in the nearby positions Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded, the same as Tuesday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 110 percent, unchanged from Tuesday, offer 117-1/2 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points from Tuesday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 100 percent, unchanged from Tuesday, no offer.
- One barge, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi, next week, bid 140 percent, up five percentage points, similar from Tuesday, no offer.
- One barge, Peoria, Illinois, on station, no bid, offer 105 percent, unchanged from Tuesday.
